arabic_text: وَجَلِّلْنِي سَوابِغَ نَعْمَائِكَ، وَظَاهِرْ لَدَيَّ فَضْلَكَ وَطَوْلَكَ،
transliteration: wa jalilni sawabigha na'ma'ik waẓāhir ladayya faḍlaka wa ṭawlaka
english_text: wrap me in Thy ample favours, and clothe me in Thy bounty and Thy graciousness!

arabic_text: وَأَيْدْنِي بِتَوْفِيقِكَ وَتَسْدِيْدِكَ، وَأَعِنِّي عَلَى صالِحِ النِّيَّةِ وَمَرْضِيِّ الْقَوْلِ وَمُسْتَحْسَنِ الْعَمَلِ.
transliteration: waʾaydnī bi tawfīqika wa tasdīdika wa'a`inni `ala ṣāliḥi al-niyyah wa marḍiyyi al-qawl wa mustaḥsani al-`amal
english_text: Strengthen me with Thy giving success and Thy pointing the right way, help me toward righteous intention, pleasing words, and approved works,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إلَى حَوْلِي وَقُوَّتِي دُونَ حَوْلِكَ وَقُوَّتِكَ،
transliteration: wa lā takilnī ilā ḥawlī wa quwwatī dūna ḥawlik wa quwwatik
english_text: and entrust me not to my force and my strength in place of Thy force and Thy strength!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَخْزِنِي يَوْمَ تَبْعَثُنِي لِلِقائِكَ، وَلاَ تَفْضَحْنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْ أَوْلِياِئكَ، وَلاَ تُنْسِنِي ذِكْرَكَ، وَلاَ تُذْهِبْ عَنِّي شُكْرَكَ، بَلْ أَلْزِمْنِيهِ فِي أَحْوَالِ السَّهْوِ عِنْدَ غَفَلاَتِ الْجَاهِلِينَ لاِلائِكَ،
transliteration: walā takhzinī yawma tabʿathunī lilqāʾika walā tafḍaḥnī bayna yaday awliyā'ika walā tunsinī dhikrak, walā tudhhib 'annī shukrak bal alzimniihi fi aḥwaali alssahwi ʿinda ghafalati aljāhiliyna lailāka
english_text: Degrade me not on the day Thou raisest me up to meet Thee, disgrace me not before Thy friends, make me not forget remembering Thee, take not away from me thanking Thee, but enjoin it upon me in states of inattention when the ignorant are heedless of Thy boons,

arabic_text: وَأَوْزِعْنِي أَنْ أُثْنِيَ بِمَا أَوْلَيْتَنِيهِ، وَأَعْتَرِفِ بِمَا أَسْدَيْتَهُ إلَيَّ،
transliteration: wa-awziʿnī an uthniya bimā awlaytanīh wa'a'tarifu bima asdaytahu ilayya
english_text: and inspire me to laud what Thou hast done for me and confess to what Thou hast conferred upon me!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ رَغْبَتِي إلَيْكَ فَوْقَ رَغْبَةِ الْرَّاغِبِينَ، وَحَمْدِي إيَّاكَ فَوْقَ حَمْدِ الْحَامِدِيْنَ،
transliteration: wajʿal raghbatī ilayka fawqa raghbatil-rāghibīn wa ḥamdī iyyāka fawqa ḥamdi al-ḥāmidīn
english_text: Place my beseeching Thee above the beseeching of the beseechers and my praise of Thee above the praise of the praisers!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَخْذُلْنِي عِنْدَ فاقَتِي إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تُهْلِكْنِي بِمَا أَسْدَيْتُهُ إلَيْكَ، وَلاَ تَجْبَهْنِي بِمَا جَبَهْتَ بِهِ لْمَعَانِدِينَ لَكَ، فَإنِّي لَكَ مُسَلِّمٌ، أَعْلَمُ أَنَّ الْحُجَّةَ لَكَ،
transliteration: wa lā takhẓulnī ʿinda faqatī ʾilayk walā tuhlíknī bimā asdaytuhu ʾilayk wa la tajbahni bima jabahta bihi lima'anidin laka fa inni laka muslimun, aʿlamu anna al-hujjata laka
english_text: Abandon me not with my neediness for Thee, destroy me not for what I have done for Thee, and slap not my brow with that with which Thou slappest the brow of those who contend with Thee, for I am submitted to Thee. I know that the argument is Thine,

arabic_text: وَأَنَّكَ أَوْلَى بِالْفَضْلِ، وَأَعْوَدُ بِالاحْسَانِ، وَأَهْلُ التَّقْوَى، وَأَهْلُ الْمَغْفِرَةِ، وَأَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَعْفُوَ أَوْلَى مِنْكَ بِأَنْ تُعَاقِبَ، وَأَنَّكَ بِأَنْ تَسْتُرَ أَقْرَبُ مِنْكَ إلَى أنْ تَشْهَرَ،
transliteration: wa-annaka a'wla bil-fadli, wa-a'wadu bil-ihsani wa-aahl al-taqwá, wa-aahl al-maghfirah wa-annaka bi-an taʿfuwa aula minaka bi-an tuʿaqiba wa-annaka bi-an tastura aqrabu minka ila an tashhara
english_text: that Thou art closest to bounty, most accustomed to beneficence, "worthy of reverent fear, and worthy of forgiveness" (75:56), that Thou art closer to pardoning than to punishing, and that Thou art nearer to covering over than to making notorious!

arabic_text: فَأَحْيِنِي حَياةً طَيِّبَةً تَنْتَظِمُ بِما أُرِيدُ وَتَبْلُغُ مَا أُحِبُّ مِنْ حَيْثُ لاَ آتِي مَا تَكْرَهُ وَلاَ أَرْتَكِبُ مَا نَهَيْتَ عَنْهُ،
transliteration: fa'ahyini hayatan tayyibatan tantazimu bima uridu wa tablughu ma uhibbu min haythu la ati ma takrah wa lā ʾartakibu mā nahayta ʿanhu
english_text: Let me live an agreeable life that will tie together what I want and reach what I love while I not bring what Thou dislikest and not commit what Thou hast prohibited;

arabic_text: وَأَمِتْنِي مِيْتَةَ مَنْ يَسْعَى نُورُهُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، وَعَنْ يِمِيِنهِ،
transliteration: wa amitni mītata man yasʿā nūruhu bayna yadayhi, wa ʿan yimīnih
english_text: and make me die the death of him whose light runs before him and on his right hand!

arabic_text: وَذَلِّلْنِي بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ، وَأَعِزَّنِيْ عِنْدَ خَلْقِكَ، وَضَعْنِي إذَا خَلَوْتُ بِكَ، وَارْفَعْنِي بَيْنَ عِبادِكَ، وَأَغْنِنِي عَمَّنْ هُوَ غَنِيٌّ عَنِّي، وَزِدْنِي إلَيْكَ فَاقَةً وَفَقْراً،
transliteration: wadhallilni bayna yadayka, wa a'izzani 'indaka waḍaʿnī idhā khalawtu bika, wa-arfaʿnī bayna ʿibādika wa-aghneeni ʿamman huwa ghaniyyun ʿanni wa-zidni ilayka faqatan wa faqrā
english_text: Abase me before Thyself and exalt me before Thy creatures, lower me when I am alone with Thee and raise me among Thy servants, free me from need for him who has no need of me and increase me in neediness and poverty toward Thee!

arabic_text: وَأَعِذْنِي مِنْ شَمَاتَةِ الاَعْدَاءِ، وَمِنْ حُلُولِ الْبَلاءِ، وَمِنَ الذُّلِّ وَالْعَنَآءِ،
transliteration: wa'aʿidhni min shamātati al-aʿdāʾi wa min ḥulūlil-balāʾi, wa minal-ḏulli wal-ʿanāʾi
english_text: Give me refuge from the gloating of enemies, the arrival of affliction, lowliness and suffering!

arabic_text: تَغَمَّدني فِيمَا اطَّلَعْتَ عَلَيْهِ مِنِّي بِمَا يَتَغَمَّدُ بِهِ الْقَادِرُ عَلَى الْبَطْشِ لَوْلاَ حِلْمُهُ، وَالاخِذُ عَلَى الْجَرِيرَةِ لَوْلاَ أَناتُهُ،
transliteration: taghammadnī fīmā aṭṭalʿaʿtā ʿalayhi minnī bimā yataghammadu bih al-qādiru ʿalā al-baṭshi lawlā ḥilmuhu wa al-akhidhu ʿalā al-jarīrah, lawlā anātuhu
english_text: Shield me in what Thou seest from me, the shielding of him who would have power over violence had he no clemency, and would seize for misdeeds had he no lack of haste!

arabic_text: وَإذَا أَرَدْتَ بِقَوْم فِتْنَةً أَوْ سُوءً فَنَجِّنِي مِنْهَا لِواذاً بِكَ،
transliteration: wa-idha aradta biqawmin fitnatan aw su'an fanajjini minha li-wadhankan bi-ka
english_text: When Thou desirest for a people a trial or an evil, deliver me from it, for I seek Thy shelter;

arabic_text: وَإذْ لَمْ تُقِمْنِي مَقَامَ فَضِيحَة فِي دُنْيَاكَ فَلاَ تُقِمْنِي مِثْلَهُ فِيْ آخِرَتِكَ،
transliteration: wa-idh lam tuqimni maqaman fadhihah fi dunyaka fala tuqimni mithlahu fi akhiratika
english_text: and since Thou hast not stood me in the station of disgrace in this world of Thine, stand me not in such a station in the next world of Thine!

arabic_text: وَاشْفَعْ لِي أَوَائِلَ مِنَنِكَ بِأَوَاخِرِهَا، وَقَدِيمَ فَوَائِدِكَ بِحَوَادِثِهَا.
transliteration: wašfaʿ li ʾawāʾila minnik biʾawāḫirihā waqadīma fawāʾidika biḥawādithihā
english_text: Couple for me the beginnings of Thy kindnesses with their ends and the ancient of Thy benefits with the freshly risen!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَمْدُدْ لِيَ مَدّاً يَقْسُو مَعَهُ قَلْبِي،
transliteration: walā tamdud liya maddan yaqsu maʿahu qalbī
english_text: Prolong not my term with a prolonging through which my heart will harden!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَقْرَعْنِي قَارِعَةً يَذْهَبُ لَها بَهَآئِي،
transliteration: wa lā taqraʿnī qāriʿatan yaẓhabu lahā bahāʾī
english_text: Strike me not with a striking that will take away my radiance!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسُمْنِي خَسِيْسَةً يَصْغُرُ لَهَا قَدْرِي، وَلاَ نَقِيصَةً يُجْهَلُ مِنْ أَجْلِهَا مَكَانِي،
transliteration: wa lā tasumnī khasīsatayn yaṣghuru lahā qadri wa lā naqīṣatan yujhalu min ajlihā makānī
english_text: Visit me not with a meanness that will diminish my worth or a deficiency that will keep my rank unknown!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَرُعْنِي رَوْعَةً أُبْلِسُ بِها، وَلاَ خِيْفةً أوجِسُ دُونَهَا.
transliteration: walā taruʿnī rawʿatan ʾublisu bihā, walā khiyfatan awjisu dūnahā
english_text: Frighten me not with a fright by which I will despair or a terror through which I will dread,

arabic_text: اجْعَلْ هَيْبَتِي في وَعِيدِكَ، وَحَذَرِي مِنْ إعْذارِكَ وَإنْذَارِكَ، وَرَهْبَتِي عِنْدَ تِلاَوَةِ آياتِكَ،
transliteration: ijʿal haybatī fī waʿīdika waḥaḏari min iʿḏārika wa-inḏārika wa rahbatī ʿinda tilāwat āyātika
english_text: but make me stand in awe of Thy threat, take precautions against Thy leaving no excuses and Thy warning, and tremble at the recitation of Thy verses!

arabic_text: وَاعْمُرْ لَيْلِي بِإيقَاظِي فِيهِ لِعِبَادَتِكَ، وَتَفَرُّدِي بِالتَّهَجُّدِ لَكَ، وَتَجَرُّدِي بِسُكُونِي إلَيْكَ، وَإنْزَالِ حَوَائِجِي بِكَ، وَمُنَازَلَتِي إيَّاكَ فِي فَكَاكِ رَقَبَتِي مِنْ نَارِكَ،
transliteration: wa aʿmur layli bi-iqāqī fīhi li-ʿibādatika wa tafarrudi bi-ttahajjudi laka, wa tajarrudi bi-sukooni ilayk wa inzāli ḥawāʾijī bika wa munāzalatī iyyāka fī fakāki raqabatī min nārika
english_text: Fill my night with life by keeping me awake therein for worshipping Thee, solitude with vigil for Thee, exclusive devotion to reliance upon Thee, setting my needs before Thee, and imploring that Thou wilt set my neck free from the Fire

arabic_text: وَإجَارَتِي مِمَّا فِيهِ أَهْلُهَا مِنْ عَذَابِكَ.
transliteration: wa-ijāratī mimmā fīhi ahluhā min ʿathābika
english_text: and grant me sanctuary from Thy chastisement, within which its inhabitants dwell!

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَذَرْنِي فِي طُغْيَانِي عَامِهاً، وَلاَ فِي غَمْرَتِي سَاهِياً حَتَّى حِين، وَلاَ تَجْعَلْنِي عِظَةً لِمَنِ اتَّعَظَ، وَلاَ نَكَالاً لِمَنِ اعْتَبَرَ، وَلاَ فِتْنَةً لِمَن نَظَرَ، وَلاَ تَمْكُرْ بِيَ فِيمَنْ تَمْكُرُ بِهِ،
transliteration: walā taḏarnī fī ṭughyānī ʿāmihan walā fī ghamratī sāhīyan ḥattā ḥīn wala taj'alni 'izatan limani at'ta'atha, wa la naqalan limani 'etabar wa lā fitnatan liman naẓara, wa lā tamkur biya fīman tamkuruhu
english_text: Leave me not blindly wandering in my insolence or inattentive in my perplexity for a time, make me not an admonition to him who takes admonishment, a punishment exemplary for him who takes heed, a trial for him who observes, devise not against me along with those against whom Thou devisest,

arabic_text: وَلاَ تَسْتَبْدِلْ بِيَ غَيْرِي، وَلاَ تُغَيِّرْ لِيْ إسْماً، وَلاَ تُبدِّلْ لِي جِسْماً، وَلاَ تَتَّخِذْنِي هُزُوَاً لِخَلْقِكَ، وَلاَ سُخْرِيّاً لَكَ، وَلاَ تَبَعاً إلاَّ لِمَرْضَاتِكَ، وَلاَ مُمْتَهَناً إلاَّ بِالانْتِقَامِ لَكَ، وَأَوْجِدْنِي بَرْدَ عَفْوِكَ،
transliteration: walā tastabdil biya ghayri, walā tughayyir li isman walā tubaddil lī jisman, walā tattakhidhnī huzūan li-khalqika wa lā sukhriyyan laka, wa lā tabaʿan illā li-marḍātika walā mumtahana illa bil-intiqāmi laka, wa awjidnī barda ʿafwik
english_text: replace me not with another, change not my name, transform not my body, appoint me not a mockery for Thy creatures, a laughing-stock for Thyself, a follower of anything but Thy good pleasure, a menial servant for anything but avenging Thee! Let me find the coolness of Thy pardon

arabic_text: و حَلاَوَةَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَرَوْحِكَ وَرَيْحَانِكَ وَجَنَّةِ نَعِيْمِكَ،
transliteration: wa ḥalāwata raḥmatika wa rūḥika wa rayḥānika wa jannati naʿīmika
english_text: and the sweetness of Thy mercy, Thy repose, Thy ease, and the garden of Thy bliss!

arabic_text: وَأَذِقْنِي طَعْمَ الْفَرَاغِ لِمَا تُحِبُّ بِسَعَة مِنْ سَعَتِكَ، وَالاجْتِهَادِ فِيمَا يُزْلِفُ لَدَيْكَ وَعِنْدَك، وَأَتْحِفْنِي بِتُحْفَة مِنْ تُحَفَاتِكَ،
transliteration: wa-ʾadhiqnee ṭaʿma al-faraagh limaa tuḥibbu bisaʿatin min saʿatika wa al-ijtihād fīmā yuzlifu ladayka wa ʿindaka wa'atḥifnī bi tuḥfatim min tuḥafātika
english_text: Let me taste, through some of Thy boundless plenty, the flavour of being free for what Thou lovest and striving in what brings about proximity with Thee and to Thee, and give me a gift from among Thy gifts!

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ تِجَارَتِي رَابِحَةً، وَكَرَّتِي غَيْرَ خَاسِرَة، وَأَخِفْنِي مَقَامَكَ، وَشَوِّقْنِي لِقاءَكَ، وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ تَوْبَةً نَصُوحاً لاَ تُبْقِ مَعَهَا ذُنُوباً صِغِيرَةً وَلا كَبِيرَةً، وَلاَ تَذَرْ مَعَهَا عَلاَنِيَةً وَلاَ سَرِيرَةً،
transliteration: waajʿal tijaarati raabihatan, wakarati ghayra khaasirah wa-akhifnī maqāmaka, wa-shawwiqnī liqā'aka wa tub ʿalayya tawbatan naṣūḥan lā tubqi maʿahā dhunūban ṣaghīratan walā kabīratan walā taẓar maʿahā ʿalāniyatun walā sariyratun
english_text: Make my commerce profitable and my return without loss, fill me with fear of Thy station, make me yearn for the meeting with Thee, and allow me to repent with an unswerving repentance along with which Thou lettest no sins remain, small or large, and leavest no wrongs, open or secret!

arabic_text: وَانْزَعِ الْغِلَّ مِنْ صَدْرِي لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ، وَاعْطِفْ بِقَلْبِي عَلَى الْخَاشِعِيْنَ، وَكُنْ لِي كَمَا تَكُونُ لِلصَّالِحِينَ، وَحَلِّنِي حِلْيَةَ الْمُتَّقِينَ،
transliteration: waanzaʿi al-ghilla min sadrii lilmuʾminin wa'atif biqalbi 'ala al-khashi'īn wa kun li kama takun li al-salihin wa hallinii hilyata al-muttaqeen
english_text: Root out rancour toward the faithful from my breast, bend my heart toward the humble, be toward me as Thou art toward the righteous, adorn me with the adornment of the godfearing,

arabic_text: وَاجْعَلْ لِيَ لِسَانَ صِدْق فِي الْغَابِرِيْنَ، وَذِكْراً نامِياً فِي الاخِرِينَ، وَوَافِ بِيَ عَرْصَةَ الاَوَّلِينَ،
transliteration: wajʿal liya lisāna ṣidq fī al-ghābirīn wa dhikran nāmiyan fī al-ākhiriyna, wa wāfi biya arṣata al-awwalīna
english_text: appoint for me a goodly report among those yet to come and a growing remembrance among the later folk, and take me to the plain of those who came first!
